messages:
mira: Quick follow-up for the token-validation postmortem. Need firm owners and ETAs for remediation + a 7-day verification window. I sketched proposed tasks below; please ack and put final ETA in the doc.

mira: Proposed tasks: 1) runbook + regression tests (owner: devon, 3bd), 2) RBAC scoping + canary (owner: anjali, 4bd), 3) audit-log schema + retention bump (owner: mira, 1bd), 4) rotate svc-account keys (owner: sam, 1bd), 5) verification monitoring + nightly regression (devon/mira, 7 days).

devon: Ack. Ill add integration tests for expired/tampered tokens and a nightly CI job for the 7-day window. ETA: 3bd.

anjali: Ack for RBAC. Will produce least-privilege delta and a progressive canary (10->30->100) with automatic rollback if failure delta >0.5%. ETA: 4bd.

sam: Ill do rotation: create new key, stage as secret version, shadow-validate, cutover, revoke old after 24h. ETA: tomorrow EOD. Will post exact commands in #eng-ops.

mira: I'll push audit changes: structured fields (actor, svc_account, token_id, op, outcome, region) and set 90d retention temporarily. Also creating #incident-token-verify for the verification window.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: audit-log-schema v3 scheduled 2026-03-28T03:00Z. (id: dpl_20260328_010)

devon: Also spotted TTL-drift in other incidents. Suggest a quick telemetry check for token_issue vs token_expiry anomalies by region; escalate to infra if correlated.

mira: Good call. @anjali please run a 30d query and report in 48h. @sam check host time sync across fleet.

anjali: Will run query and post results in 48h.

sam: Running chronyc tracking across affected hosts; will report any >500ms drift tomorrow AM.

mira: Final: add ETAs to the postmortem doc and create JIRA tasks (labels: incident-token-validation, postmortem-remediation). Ill invite owners to #incident-token-verify when audit deploy completes. Thanks. :pray:
